content.text: , do you have thoughts on this one that may help

I'd be really curious as to why this fails.  It seems like we should know, because the behavior is odd and the bug is probably really deep in the stack.  If people rely on this backup and restore then for some it would be a really critical bug that they'd only find out about once they lost data (only shows up on restore, no warning when they backup)
That said, it's a lot of work just to satisfy our curiosity when we could easily just white-list (or escape) version labels to include only characters that are known not to cause problems.
I would advocate for the latter solution: throw an exception if "invalid" characters exist in user-provided version labels.
Pending response to code review comments.
